name: dumbbell russian twist close grip shoulder press sit up
description: A compound core move that links a sit-up, a Russian twist and an overhead press with a dumbbell.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Sit up and rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate back to center and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down.
